_comment: ZeRO-3 variant, provided so you can MEASURE that it does not help. This is not the recommended config -- ds_config.json is. Run both at a longer --n-res and compare peak memory: stage 3 shards ~100k parameters across your ranks and leaves the O(N_res^3) triangle attention activation exactly where it was. MEASURED on 1x RTX 3080 Ti at --n-res 128: stage 1 = 0.65 GB, stage 3 = 0.62 GB.
_controlled_comparison_comment: This file is byte-identical to ds_config.json except for the zero_optimization block, and that is load-bearing. An earlier version left reduce_bucket_size unset in ds_config.json, where DeepSpeed defaults it to 5e8 (500 MB) against the 16 MB set here -- so the comparison read 1.58 GB vs 0.62 GB and appeared to prove stage 3 saves 2.5x. It was measuring bucket sizes. If you change a knob here, change it there too, or the experiment stops being an experiment.
_precision_comment: bf16, matching ds_config.json -- DS4Sci_EvoformerAttention has no fp32 path.
_zero_comment: Stage 3 shards parameters as well as gradients and optimizer state, at about 1.5x the communication volume of stage 2. On a 100k-parameter trunk that buys essentially nothing and costs real bandwidth. Kept as a controlled experiment, not as advice. If stage 3 DOES help your run, the model you are training is not the one this lab ships -- check whether you raised c_z or the block count into real-parameter territory.
